//: Default Cynara API configuration. Connection strings and other secrets MUST come from environment variables (ConnectionStrings__Default, OPENAI_API_KEY, etc.) — never from this file. The Default connection string below is a placeholder that omits the credential; in any deployed environment set ConnectionStrings__Default (or ConnectionStrings__Prod) as an env var and the host value is restored from there. For local development against the docker-stack Postgres (docker/stack.yml) see appsettings.Development.json.

Cors.//: Origins allowed to call the API via browser fetch / XHR. AllowedOriginPatterns are regexes matched against the Origin header. Preview trust is anchored on the Cloudflare ACCOUNT subdomain (livesanty.workers.dev): only deployments of that account can exist there, so any worker name (hash, branch, or PR-based) is accepted while other accounts' *.workers.dev stays denied.

ConnectionStrings.//: The infrastructure layer picks one of these named connection strings based on ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: 'Production' selects 'Prod', any other value selects 'Default'. The Default value is a non-credentialed placeholder; supply a credential via env var when the database requires one.

WebClient.//: Config-driven OIDC redirect origins for the cynara-web client, merged at startup in EVERY environment (idempotent, add-only; existing registrations keep their permissions and URIs). Each entry derives <origin>/en/login and <origin>/es/login. Production lists the real web domains here; preview pipelines append their origin via OpenIddict__WebClient__RedirectOrigins__N. Creating a brand-new client additionally requires OpenIddict:WebClient:Secret (never commit it).

Hospitals.//: Bootstrap workspace created on first boot when AllowAutoBootstrap is true. HeaderName is the request header used to resolve the hospital tenant on every call.

SonarQube.//: Local SonarQube connection used by Cursor MCP servers (.cursor/sonarqube-mcp.sh reads these via _read-appsettings-env.sh). URL is the host the MCP container reaches the server on (the docker network 'cynara-net'); the operator-facing URL stays at http://localhost:9000. TokenFile points at the file written by the local bootstrap (scripts/sonar-bootstrap.sh).
